before: Chasers continuously move toward the player and deal damage through body contact.
after: Chasers continuously move toward the player at 150 px/s and deal damage through body contact.

before: `WASD: Move    Mouse: Aim    Left Click: Shoot`
after: `WASD: Move Mouse: Aim Left Click: Shoot`
The increased movement speed does not change the Chaser collision radius, contact threshold, damage value, or movement algorithm.
- Chasers: 3, each at 2 HP and 150 px/s movement speed
- Shooters: 3, each at 3 HP and 90 px/s movement speed

before: 3. Update surviving Chaser and Shooter movement, Shooter firing timers, line-of-sight checks, and enemy-bullet spawning.
after: 3. Update surviving Chaser movement at 150 px/s and Shooter movement at 90 px/s, Shooter firing timers, line-of-sight checks, and enemy-bullet spawning.

before: - All Shooter positions, HP, and firing timers.
after: - All Chaser positions, HP, and movement speed of 150 px/s.
- All Shooter positions, HP, movement speed, and firing timers.
Chasers move toward the player's current position at 150 px/s.
